title: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
abstract: arXiv:2610.40917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models act only through the infrastructure that surrounds them. That infrastructure, the harness, determines what a model can accomplish and how it fails, yet it has no settled definition. To address this gap, we decompose the harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and we propose a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness. The record is needed because different harness configurations can yield several-fold differences in reported scores for the same model, and because much of an agent's attack surface lies in its harness. Existing model cards and agent cards provide release and operational information, but do not establish the sequence of effective configurations within a run. translated_title: 迈向智能体线束的可移植规范
translated_abstract: 大语言模型只有通过围绕其周边的基础设施才能产生行动。这一基础设施，即线束，决定了模型能够完成什么以及如何失败，然而它至今没有一个确定的定义。为了填补这一空白，我们将线束分解为八个可以在不同系统之间进行规范化和比较的功能组件，并提出了一个可移植的规范框架，用于记录哪个模型在哪个线束中运行。这种记录是必要的，因为不同的线束配置会使同一模型的报告得分产生数倍的差异，而且智能体的大部分攻击面都存在于其线束之中。现有的模型卡和智能体卡提供了发布与运营信息，但没有建立一次运行中有效配置的序列。线束可能在版本发布之间和运行之间发生变化；当智能体编辑自己的工具和配置时，甚至在单次运行之内也会发生变化。已颁布的人工智能法律包含文档……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将决定大语言模型行动能力与失效方式的“线束”基础设施分解为八个可跨系统规范化和比较的功能组件，并提出可移植的规范框架来记录模型与线束的配对关系，以应对线束配置差异导致同一模型得分相差数倍以及大部分攻击面位于线束中的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes the agent harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and proposes a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness, addressing the several-fold score differences and the large attack surface introduced by harness configurations.
